headline: Peru Central Reserve Bank Approves QR Perú Standard for Digital Payments
summary: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru approved the QR Perú standard to establish common rules for QR code payments and strengthen digital payments infrastructure.
why: Standardizing interoperable digital payments promotes financial inclusion and reduces transaction costs across Peru's financial system.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Interoperable QR payment standards facilitate digital transactions and banking efficiency.
